title: Fill Zwischenbericht Cover Page and Maximize Arbeitsprobe Window
description: zwischenbericht mit bestand: The first page is not properly filled. e.g. the arbeitsprobe can take more space must properly cover the window
summary: The cover column under-filled the page because WindowColumn over-reserved per-item chrome and both covers carried a -1.2cm fudge; the Arbeitsprobe was a hand-sized includegraphics in a padded minipage. WindowColumn now floors tab heights, measures its real chrome from reference windows and renders as one box of exactly the declared height; generic Window honours image-fit=cover; the cover-fit target height is the true body. Covers use \textheight and the Arbeitsprobe uses image-fit=cover. Verified: Zwischenbericht, Forschungsbericht, Kompaktbericht and PhD covers all measure ink 42.5 to 799.0 pt (page 842, margins 42.5); full Zwischenbericht rebuilt (193 pages). Manual bookkeeping (ticket_open and ticket_close returned malformed results). Report: 📓️report.md.
